Interface DeathNote

All Known Implementing Classes:
DeathNoteImpl
public interface DeathNote
A DeathNote is a special book intended to be used by Shinigamis (Death gods) to kill humans, thereby extending their own lives. Each DeathNote has a set of rules that must be followed in order to use it properly.

  • Method Details

    • getRule

      String getRule(int ruleNumber)
      Returns the rule with the given number.
      Parameters:
      ruleNumber - the number of the rule to return. The first rule has number one
      Returns:
      the rule with the given number
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the given rule number is smaller than 1 or larger than the number of rules

    • writeName

      void writeName(String name)
      The human whose name is written in this DeathNote will die.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the human to kill
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the given name is null.

    • writeDeathCause

      boolean writeDeathCause(String cause)
      If the cause of death is written within the next 40 milliseconds of writing the person's name, it will happen.
      Parameters:
      cause - the cause of the human's death
      Returns:
      true if the cause was written within 40 milliseconds, false otherwise
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if there is no name written in this DeathNote, or the cause is null

    • writeDetails

      boolean writeDetails(String details)
      After writing the cause of death, details of the death should be written in the next 6 seconds and 40 milliseconds.
      Parameters:
      details - the details of the human's death
      Returns:
      true if the details were written within 6 seconds and 40 milliseconds, false otherwise
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if there is no name written in this DeathNote, or the details are null

    • getDeathCause

      String getDeathCause(String name)
      Provides the cause of death of the person with the given name.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the person whose death cause to return
      Returns:
      the death cause of the person with the given name. If the cause of death is not specified, the method will return "heart attack".
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provider name is not written in this DeathNote

    • getDeathDetails

      String getDeathDetails(String name)
      Provides the details of the death of the person with the given name.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the person whose death cause to return
      Returns:
      the death details of the person with the given name, or an empty string if no details have been provided.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provider name is not written in this DeathNote.
